question.html:
a A stationary isotope of 88Ra (Radium) decays into Rn (Radon) and an alpha particle.

a.i Identify the proton number of Rn. [1]

The following data are available:

Atomic mass of Ra

= 226.02540 u

Atomic mass of Rn

= 222.01757 u

Mass of 

= 4.00260 u

a.ii Show that the energy released in this decay is about 5 MeV. [2]

a.iii Show that about 98 % of the energy released is carried by the alpha particle. [2]

b In an experiment performed by Geiger, Marsden and Rutherford to investigate the atomic structure, alpha particles were directed into a thin metal foil.

b.i Describe two observations of this experiment. [2]

b.ii Outline how the experiment was interpreted. [2]
